subject: select widgets with R data sets

messages.author: ff58459fd7901f91
messages.subject: select widgets with R data sets
parts: I'm building a Shiny app that uses RSQLite on the server side to fetch data from SQLITE.  I'm creating a select widget that should use the results of the query as options for the user to choose from, but I can't seem to find any examples that use an output from the server in this way.  All of them just pass it to HTML rendering functions.  Is this possible?

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: select widgets with R data sets
parts: Do you want to store the queries in the selectInput and have them executed when selected or are you creating the datasets beforehand? Either could work. For the 2nd option you could store the datasets in a reactive value (?reactiveValues) and 'open' them with the selectInput. For the first option you could put the queries in a list with the labels shown as options in the selectInput.
